# Keyboard shortcuts

Raml KQL uses VS Code shortcuts wherever the same action exists. Change or remove any of them in `keybindings.jsonc` (**Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts (JSON)**, <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd>), which uses the same format as VS Code:

```jsonc
[
  { "key": "ctrl+shift+r", "command": "query.run" },
  // A leading "-" removes a default shortcut:
  { "key": "shift+enter", "command": "-query.run" },
]
```

A few actions have more than one shortcut; all are listed. The Command Palette (<kbd>F1</kbd>) lists every command, including those without a shortcut.

## Quick access

| Action                                              | macOS           | Windows and Linux  |
| --------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------ |
| Show All Commands (`workbench.action.showCommands`) | F1 or ⌘+Shift+P | F1 or Ctrl+Shift+P |
| Go to Query... (`workbench.action.quickOpen`)       | ⌘+E or ⌘+P      | Ctrl+E or Ctrl+P   |

## Queries

| Action                        | macOS                  | Windows and Linux         |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------- |
| New Query (`query.new`)       | ⌘+N                    | Ctrl+N                    |
| Save (`query.save`)           | ⌘+S                    | Ctrl+S                    |
| Save As… (`query.saveAs`)     | ⌘+Shift+S              | Ctrl+Shift+S              |
| Run Query (`query.run`)       | ⌘+Enter or Shift+Enter | Ctrl+Enter or Shift+Enter |
| Cancel Query (`query.cancel`) | Esc                    | Esc                       |

## Editor

| Action                                            | macOS       | Windows and Linux |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ----------------- |
| Format Document (`editor.action.formatDocument`)  | Shift+Alt+F | Ctrl+Shift+I      |
| Toggle Line Comment (`editor.action.commentLine`) | ⌘+/         | Ctrl+/            |
| Find (`actions.find`)                             | ⌘+F         | Ctrl+F            |
| Replace (`editor.action.startFindReplaceAction`)  | Alt+⌘+F     | Ctrl+H            |

## Layout

| Action                                                                          | macOS    | Windows and Linux |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------- |
| Toggle Primary Side Bar Visibility (`workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility`) | ⌘+B      | Ctrl+B            |
| Toggle Panel Visibility (`workbench.action.togglePanel`)                        | ⌘+J      | Ctrl+J            |
| Toggle Full Screen (`workbench.action.toggleFullScreen`)                        | Ctrl+⌘+F | F11               |

## Views

| Action                                        | macOS     | Windows and Linux |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------- | ----------------- |
| Show Targets (`workbench.view.targets`)       | ⌘+Shift+E | Ctrl+Shift+E      |
| Show Library (`workbench.view.library`)       | ⌘+Shift+L | Ctrl+Shift+L      |
| Show History (`workbench.view.history`)       | ⌘+Shift+H | Ctrl+Shift+H      |
| Show Extensions (`workbench.view.extensions`) | ⌘+Shift+X | Ctrl+Shift+X      |

## Tabs and groups

| Action                                                                                                 | macOS           | Windows and Linux  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- | ------------------ |
| Close Editor (`workbench.action.closeActiveEditor`)                                                    | ⌘+F4 or ⌘+W     | Ctrl+F4 or Ctrl+W  |
| Split Editor Right (`workbench.action.splitEditor`)                                                    | ⌘+\             | Ctrl+\             |
| Focus First Editor Group (`workbench.action.focusFirstEditorGroup`)                                    | ⌘+1             | Ctrl+1             |
| Focus Second Editor Group (`workbench.action.focusSecondEditorGroup`)                                  | ⌘+2             | Ctrl+2             |
| Focus Third Editor Group (`workbench.action.focusThirdEditorGroup`)                                    | ⌘+3             | Ctrl+3             |
| Focus Fourth Editor Group (`workbench.action.focusFourthEditorGroup`)                                  | ⌘+4             | Ctrl+4             |
| Open Previous Recently Used Editor in Group (`workbench.action.openPreviousRecentlyUsedEditorInGroup`) | Ctrl+Tab        | Ctrl+Tab           |
| Keep Editor (`workbench.action.keepEditor`)                                                            | ⌘+K Enter       | Ctrl+K Enter       |
| Pin Editor (`workbench.action.pinEditor`)                                                              | ⌘+K Shift+Enter | Ctrl+K Shift+Enter |

## Settings

| Action                                                                        | macOS   | Windows and Linux |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------- |
| Open Settings (UI) (`workbench.action.openSettings`)                          | ⌘+,     | Ctrl+,            |
| Open Keyboard Shortcuts (JSON) (`workbench.action.openGlobalKeybindingsFile`) | ⌘+K ⌘+S | Ctrl+K Ctrl+S     |
| Color Theme (`workbench.action.selectTheme`)                                  | ⌘+K ⌘+T | Ctrl+K Ctrl+T     |

## Window

| Action                                                     | macOS      | Windows and Linux |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------- |

| Zoom Out (`workbench.action.zoomOut`)                      | ⌘+-        | Ctrl+-            |

| Toggle Developer Tools (`workbench.action.toggleDevTools`) | Alt+⌘+I    | Ctrl+Shift+I      |

## Privacy

| Action                                                      | macOS   | Windows and Linux |

| Toggle Presentation Mode (`privacy.togglePresentationMode`) | ⌘+Alt+P | Ctrl+Alt+P        |
